title: Jewish and Arab Israeli Activists Launch Counter-'Hasbara' Flotilla to Challenge Gaza-Bound GSF Fleet
detail: Jewish and Arab Israeli civil-society activists launched an unusual counter-'Hasbara' (pro-Israel public diplomacy) flotilla on May 20, 2026 to challenge the Gaza-bound Global Sumud Flotilla (GSF). The operation marks a rare joint domestic Israeli maritime civil-society initiative, with both Jewish and Arab Israeli participants boarding vessels to counter the international flotilla's narrative. The move comes as Israeli naval forces have already intercepted approximately 41 GSF vessels, with remaining boats still at sea near Gaza. The counter-flotilla reflects deepening domestic Israeli debate over the blockade and the international flotilla, as 10 foreign ministers issued a joint condemnation of Israeli actions and UN human rights experts demanded the release of detained flotilla activists.
